name: Sovrium Intranet
description: A company hub — announcements, people, resources.

BUILDPACK_URL.description: Sovrium buildpack — downloads the released, checksum-verified sovrium binary and boots the app config (Scalingo does not build Dockerfiles).

SOVRIUM_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Master key for encrypting stored credentials at rest (AES-256-GCM). Optional — the app generates and persists one on first start if unset. Keep it set here: the container filesystem is ephemeral, so a generated key would not survive a restart. Review apps get their own key: their database starts empty, so there is nothing encrypted with the parent key to read.

BASE_URL.description: Public URL of this app (e.g. https://my-intranet.osc-fr1.scalingo.io). Used for auth callbacks and absolute links. The url generator makes each review app get its own address instead of inheriting the parent app's.

NODE_ENV.description: Runtime mode. Matches the parent app so review apps behave like production.

TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS.description: Number of reverse proxies in front of the app, so client IPs and the request scheme are read from the right X-Forwarded-* entry. Scalingo puts one hop in front of every app, review apps included.

AUTH_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Bootstrap the first admin account on first start (optional — you can also run `sovrium admin create <email>` later).

AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the bootstrap admin account (used with AUTH_ADMIN_EMAIL).

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP server hostname for outbound email (sign-in links, notifications). Leave empty to run with email disabled.
